title: Settings
description: Subtitle behavior, shortcuts and app preferences.

auto_check.label: Check on Launch
auto_check.desc: Quietly check GitHub Releases on launch and only notify when there's a new version.

show_changelog.label: Show Changelog
show_changelog.desc: Read CHANGELOG.md and show the relevant entries when a new version is available.

update.target_repo_desc: New versions are checked on this GitHub repository's Releases. Nothing is downloaded automatically.

behavior.hide_foreground: Hide When PotPlayer Is in Front
behavior.hide_foreground_hint: Avoids doubling up with PotPlayer's own subtitles when you switch back to watch
behavior.hide_paused_hint: Don't show subtitles while PotPlayer is paused
behavior.primary_lang_hint: Shown as the primary line of bilingual subtitles
behavior.filter_signs_hint: Ignore positioned on-screen text and signs in ASS files
behavior.variant_hint: Preferred when both Simplified and Traditional files exist
behavior.offset_step_hint: How much each earlier/later adjustment moves
behavior.close_to_tray_hint: Closing the window keeps subtitles working; reopen from the tray icon
behavior.launch_at_login_hint: Start quietly in the tray after you sign in to Windows
behavior.compact_on_top_hint: The compact window stays above other windows

hotkeys.title: Global Shortcuts
hotkeys.description: Work inside games too. Click, then press a new combination. Esc cancels, Backspace clears.
hotkeys.conflict: Another app already uses this combination — choose a different one
